name: macleanup
description: Safe-by-default macOS cleanup CLI — 28 sections, a real dry-run, zero install via npx.

scripts.lint:bash: bash -n macleanup.sh && for f in lib/*.sh; do bash -n "$f" || exit 1; done && node -c bin/macleanup.js
scripts.version:check: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const v=require('./package.json').version;const src=[fs.readFileSync('macleanup.sh','utf8'),...fs.readdirSync('lib').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.sh')).map(f=>fs.readFileSync('lib/'+f,'utf8'))].join('');if(!src.includes('MACLEANUP_VERSION:-'+v+'}')){console.error('version mismatch: package.json '+v+' is not the SCRIPT_VERSION fallback in macleanup.sh or lib/');process.exit(1)}console.log('version parity OK: '+v)"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run --silent lint:bash && test -x macleanup.sh && test -x bin/macleanup.js && npm run --silent version:check
